correctness.rationale: PASS. Direct exact rational solution of printed (5.1), keeping -0.48Q as printed rather than replacing by Table 1 0.38, gives positive equilibrium (320/197,1371240/665663,399945/665663,1313079/665663). Table 1 parameters imply eta+d+alpha2=0.38, directly inconsistent with the numerical equation. The linearized delayed infection Jacobian has rank one, so det(lambda I-J0-z Jdelay) is affine in z=e^{-lambda tau1}, contradicting published z². Independent SymPy symbolic differentiation/determinant derivation exactly reproduced the two integer polynomials P(lambda), Q(lambda), modulus quartic F(u), whose derivative is positive for u>0 and F(0)<0; thus exactly one imaginary frequency exists. Independent numerical evaluation gives omega=0.1447950754167241, earliest tau1=13.87960223606146 and positive real derivative 0.0017462878979220143. The original omega=0.0786 gives strictly negative nonzero F(omega²), impossible at any tau1. Zero-delay Hurwitz positivity, nonzero determinant at lambda=0 and continuity of roots confirm first loss of linear stability. These computations do NOT establish nonlinear Hopf branch direction or general two-delay behavior.
